title: Sign in with Mera
text: One Face ID prompt signs in with a Mera passkey, the only account layer. No wallet extension, no seed phrase.

title: AUSD balance
text: The Passkey tab shows the account's balances on Monad, read from the chain: MON, USDC and AUSD.

title: Swap to AUSD
text: Swap USDC into AUSD through Kuru Flow: an exact approval, then the swap, each simulated first and signed with the passkey. The AUSD balance updates from the chain.

title: Trade on Perpl
text: The Hedge tab sizes a short against the MON the account holds. It deposits ten AUSD of collateral into Perpl and opens a 138 MON short on Perpl's MON perpetual.

title: The open position
text: The position is read from Perpl: size, entry and mark price, profit or loss, collateral, and a liquidation estimate.

title: Close and withdraw
text: Close buys the MON back with an immediate-or-cancel order. The collateral, 10.000117 AUSD, comes back to the wallet.

title: Flip Garden
text: Mera sign-in, an AUSD balance and trades on Perpl, in one installable app on Monad.
